summary: Added meterbill/money.py (context-free integer rounding) and routed every rounding/fixed-place format through it; removed the decimal-context line. Batch's pool threads keep their old half-even rounding of band charges and effective price via a keyword-only method parameter. Tests pass and a randomized differential run against the original showed identical CLI output. Quirks kept as-is: batch rounds those two sites half-even while bill/quote round half-up; cash 'whole' never yields a negative zero.
